name: MCP Server
description: Lets AI assistants such as Claude read and, if allowed, post in Mattermost as the signed-in user, over a remote MCP server with its own OAuth sign-in.

settings_schema.header: AI assistants connect to <Site URL>/plugins/com.scaleupconsulting.mcp/mcp and sign in as a Mattermost user, who approves each assistant on a consent page and chooses Read only or Read and write for it. Every tool sees only the teams, channels, direct messages and posts that user can see. Users review and disconnect assistants at <Site URL>/plugins/com.scaleupconsulting.mcp/connections or with /mcp.

settings.help_text: When off, sign-in, token refresh and every tool call are refused, but existing connections are kept so turning it back on restores them.

The ceiling for every connection. When on, a user approving an assistant chooses Read only or Read and write, and only Read and write lets it post messages, reply in threads and add reactions as that user. When off, nobody can grant write and existing Read and write connections lose their write tools until it is turned back on. Drafts count as reading: they are never sent.

save_draft, list_drafts and delete_draft: the user's own Mattermost drafts, which only the user can send. They count as reading, so Read only connections get them. They need Allow message drafts to sync with the server.
How long an access token works before the assistant must refresh it. 5 to 1440.
How long a connection stays signed in without being used. Each refresh issues a new refresh token and invalidates the old one. 1 to 365.
